data.title: Supplier Qualification Policy
data.content: This policy defines the requirements for qualifying a new supplier. Before onboarding, the following must be verified: (1) Financial stability — credit rating of B+ or higher, and last 3 years of audited financials. (2) Compliance certifications — GST registration and ISO 9001 (or equivalent). (3) Quality history — no open critical incidents; at most 2 medium incidents in the past 12 months. (4) ESG evidence — documented environmental and social governance practices are required. (5) Delivery performance — on-time delivery rate of 90% or higher. All evidence must be verified by the procurement team before final approval. Suppliers failing any mandatory requirement must be escalated for review.
